_doc: DERIVED, not authored. Road class inferred from the route name by tools/classify-routes.mjs; regenerate rather than hand-edit. `basis` records which rule fired, because a class inferred from a name deserves less trust than one somebody decided. CONDITION IS ABSENT ON PURPOSE: whether a road was rebuilt, abandoned or newly beaten is a fact about the fiction, it is not in the name, and guessing it would be inventing history.
